title: SpinalCordToolbox
description: Run supported SCT browser models with explicit task selection, and measure masks with ports of sct_process_segmentation and sct_analyze_lesion.

segment.title: Segment spinal anatomy
segment.description: Run the existing SCT worker and preserve every task output in the original image geometry.

image.description: MRI contrast appropriate to the selected SCT task

threshold.description: Probability threshold; omitted uses the selected model default

minimumComponentSize.description: Minimum connected-component voxel count; omitted uses model default

morphometry.title: Measure spinal cord morphometry
morphometry.description: Port of sct_process_segmentation: cross-sectional area, AP and RL diameter, eccentricity, orientation, solidity, cord angles and length of an existing mask, per slice, per vertebral level or aggregated. No inference.

segmentation.description: Mask to measure, binary or weighted in [0, 1], for example a spinal cord segmentation from the segment operation

discs.description: Intervertebral disc labels on the same grid (SCT -discfile), for example spine_discs from the segment operation with task spine; gives every slice a vertebral level

aggregate.description: slice: one row per axial slice (-perslice 1); level: one row per vertebral level (-vert -perlevel 1); levels: one row across the chosen levels (-vert); all: one row over the chosen slices. level and levels need discs

slices.description: Axial slices to include, inferior to superior, in SCT -z syntax such as 30:80 or 12;15;20:25; empty uses every slice

levels.description: Vertebral levels for aggregate level or levels, in SCT -vert syntax such as 2:5; empty uses every level found on the mask

angleCorrection.description: Correct each slice for the angle between the cord centerline and the slice (SCT -angle-corr)

maskLabel.description: Measure only voxels with this label value, for example 1 for the cord in TotalSpineSeg step 1 labels; omitted measures every non-zero voxel

lesion-metrics.title: Measure spinal cord lesions
lesion-metrics.description: Port of sct_analyze_lesion -m -s -i: volume, length, width, equivalent diameter, axial damage ratio, midsagittal measures and tissue bridges of every lesion in an existing mask. No inference.

lesion.description: Binary lesion mask, for example the lesion output of the segment operation with task lesion_sci_t2

cord.description: Spinal cord mask on the same grid; lesion voxels outside it are ignored and it gives the cord angles. Without it only lesion volume, length, width and equivalent diameter are reported (lengths not angle-corrected)

image.description: Image on the same grid; adds its mean and standard deviation inside each lesion (SCT -i)
